name: IAM Create Login Profile
description: An attacker with iam:CreateLoginProfile can set a password for an IAM user, enabling AWS Management Console access. This is used for persistence when the attacker has created a backdoor user or compromised an existing user that lacked console access. The attacker can then log in via the web console in addition to programmatic access. Required permission is iam:CreateLoginProfile. The target user must not already have a login profile.
mitigations: Prefer SSO over IAM user console
detectionStrategy: Creating a console password for an IAM user enables Management Console access. In SSO-first or programmatic-only environments, this is highly suspicious. Detection should monitor CreateLoginProfile, focus on unexpected actors and non-human target users, and correlate with ConsoleLogin for high-confidence persistence detection.
